external.title: Large spaces of bounded rank matrices revisited
external.author: Clement de Seguins Pazzis
external.inspected: Section 1.1 arbitrary-field convention and Theorem 1.1, pages 1-4
external.use: A linear space of m-by-m matrices of upper rank r has dimension at most mr, over every field. The local proof reduces finite SR(M_m)=m^2 to this external theorem.
external.credit: Flanders's bounded-rank dimension theorem; Meshulam's removal of the field-size restriction, as credited in this primary generalization. No use of equality-case classification.

local.use: Previously certified explicit F4 basis and maintained finite-field convolution primitives. The current verifier independently checks full-source block separation and degree bounds; the prior leading limit is not used for the upper bound.

Prior separately weighted algebra-block counting and coefficient-one characteristic-two transfer, with its existing external credits retained. The current finite cutoffs are proved directly and are not an asymptotic extrapolation.
